title: Request for proposal for branch appointment intake
not_questions: We will not license Adobe Target.
Use synthetic account numbers in every demonstration.
Return price schedules in whole dollars.

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Describe how an AEM Forms appointment request would let a customer select an office if their preferred branch is closed for renovations.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Explain how AEM Forms would pass the appointment reason to Salesforce while keeping the customer's account number outside the case record.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Set out how AEM Forms would recover an interrupted appointment request on a shared device. Identify the data that should disappear when the session expires.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Provide an acceptance test for a visitor who completes the appointment request using only a keyboard.

questions.label: A.5
questions.text: Explain how AEM Forms would support a guardian booking two appointments for minors without exposing one child's details on the other appointment.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Describe how Acrobat Sign would capture an appointment authorization signed by two account holders who use different email addresses.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Explain how an operations supervisor would retrieve an Acrobat Sign agreement when the branch has only the appointment identifier.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Show how a cancelled Acrobat Sign agreement would update the Salesforce case without cancelling a later appointment for the same customer.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Specify the Acrobat Sign evidence that the pilot reviewer will receive after a signer refuses the authorization.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Identify the delivery lead and backup available during our April pilot. Give the number of days each has reserved.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: Provide two references for branch intake projects delivered for deposit institutions in the past four years.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: Describe your firm's process for replacing a subcontractor who loses clearance for the bank's test environment.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: Provide a price schedule separating initial delivery, staff training and the first quarter of support.
